'''Noj Smialliw''' was a noted classical composer who wrote [[Spirit of the Republic (epic)|Spirit of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The piece was written in response to [[Vennido T'all]]'s anti-Republic music.
